name: Silhouette® Window Shadings
description: Silhouette® Window Shadings transform harsh sunlight into beautiful ambient glow with signature S-shaped vanes suspended between two sheers.

benefits.text:
Superior Light Diffusion
Silhouette shadings diffuse natural light with S-shaped fabric vanes positioned 
between two sheers. This innovative design creates a soft, warm ambiance 
throughout a room.
Incredibly Clear Views 
With the choice of specially engineered front and back ClearView® sheers, 
enjoy improved views of the outside landscape.
Expansive Fabric Selection
A wide array of beautiful fabric and color options allow Silhouette® shadings to 
easily complement any interior décor style.
UV Protection with View-Through
Silhouette shadings provide views outdoors while preventing UV rays from 
damaging furniture, flooring and artwork.
The Whole House Solution™
Silhouette shadings are intentionally designed to coordinate with vertical 
Luminette® Privacy Sheers, creating a uniform look throughout your home.
Daytime Privacy and Extraordinary Light Control
Create the precise amount of preferred light with rotating vanes. Throughout 
the day, the white rear sheer reflects light back to the outside, obscuring views 
into your home.
Benefits of Silhouette® 
shadings include 
stunning light diffusion 
and luxurious fabrics 
that enhance the 
beauty of your home.

Superior Light Deflection and Control 
Silhouette® Halo™ shadings allow you to create your ideal amount of light in 
a room as the sun moves from morning to night.  
Clear Views with UV Protection
Silhouette Halo shadings feature ClearView® sheers that offer visibility to the 
outdoors while protecting furniture, flooring and décor from UV rays.
Exceptional Privacy 
Rotating vanes provide the most customizable privacy options. 
Tilt vanes up and down to allow natural light to come in while 
enjoying as much privacy as you desire.
Enhanced Color and Texture
Designed to create a soft glow and eliminate harsh shadowing, unique 
dual-layer dimensional vanes also enhance the Silhouette Halo shading color 
and texture for a distinctly beautiful appearance. 
Silhouette® Halo™ 
shadings feature 
rotating vanes that 
can tilt up, down and 
anywhere in between, 
making it easier 
to manage light 
throughout the day.
Innovative Bottom Rail Design 
Silhouette Halo shadings have a sleek bottom rail designed to rock on the window 
sill as the shading over-rotates. The bottom panel remains a consistent size and 
provides a clean, uniform look from top to bottom.
Fabric Halo™ ClearView® Elan®    Color Burlap

Child Safety Labels on Corded Systems
These warning labels appear on window 
fashions with cords to make consumers aware 
of window cord hazards for children and pets.  
EasyRise™
A continuous cord loop system raises and 
lowers the shading by simply pulling on the cord.
UltraGlide®
A single retractable wand for enhanced child 
safety. With one click, the fabric panel drops for 
complete privacy. Pump the wand to open the 
vanes or raise the shading.
SoftTouch® Motorization
A battery-operated, cordless system. Gently pull 
down on the wand to lower shadings, or lightly 
push up to raise them.
LiteRise®
Adjust shadings with a light touch on the 
handle. Pull down to lower; push up to raise.

Specialty Shapes
From arches to angles, Silhouette shadings can cover an array of specialty
shapes. All specialty shapes are non-operable.
Two-On-One Headrail
For larger windows, two independently operated shadings can share the same 
headrail. Available with EasyRise™, LiteRise® and UltraGlide® operating systems.
Tilt Only
Best for French doors or narrow windows, this option keeps the Silhouette® 
shading lowered but allows vanes to tilt open and closed. 
A Deux™
This dual roller system features a translucent shading in front of a room-darkening 
panel, which can be independently positioned. Vanes can tilt when panel is down. 
Duolite®
With just one operation, the shading and room-darkening panel fully lower 
to provide more options for light control and privacy. Vanes remain open when 
panel is down. 
Silhouette® Halo™ Duolite
Exclusive room-darkening option for Halo shadings. With just one operation, the 
shading and room-darkening panel fully lower to provide more options for light 
control and privacy. Vanes remain over-rotated when panel is down.
Grandiose™
Best for taller windows, this feature uses the Quartette® headrail with 3-inch 
vanes. Available with EasyRise™ and limited fabrics.
Magnetic Hold-Down Brackets
Secure Silhouette shadings on French doors or sidelight applications with 
magnetic hold-down brackets. These can be used with all operating systems 
to prevent movement of the bottom rail in a window.
